blockingFindings.description: Direct V31 sit/crouch renders show the forward overskirt panels falling behind the raised thighs. Pose-matched measurement reports skirt coverage 0.22 on both upper thighs in sit and 0.36/0.37 in crouch, while under-shorts are 0.95 on both sides in both poses. A diagnostic-only sit render colors canonical panels distinctly and overlays inter-panel seam edges by dominant Hips/UpperLeg weight: 148 owner-boundary edges were identified, 144 Hips-dominant and two per thigh group; the lap-to-front-panel seam accounts for 28 edges on each side. This supports investigating the hip-dominant panel attachment/drape but does not establish a fit pass.
V31 front and crouch renders still show coarse faceting, irregular folds, and uneven pointed panel edges. Surface/silhouette remain visibly unfinished.

Direct inspection of the current rear render shows no clearly readable adjustment-tab or buckle silhouette; neither element separates visually from the garment. The preview set also has no dedicated rear close-up.
The exact current weighted prototype still has no authored UV map. UV state remains MISSING; no substitute UV was generated.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
